briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Google Gemini 3 race toward multi-agent AGI benchmarks amid surging investments

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate model releases while governments debate compute export controls. Investment remains robust across infrastructure and safety tooling. The AGI race intensifies with new benchmarks showing rapid capability gains.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with advanced multi-agent orchestration. Anthropic's Claude 4 Opus and xAI's Grok-3 both posted gains on agentic benchmarks this week. DeepSeek-R2 open weights triggered competitive responses from Meta.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. EU AI Act enforcement begins next month with new red-teaming mandates.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp reaches 1.2M units shipped. Microsoft and CoreWeave announce $4B joint data center expansion in Texas. TSMC reports 3nm AI chip yields improving faster than expected.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent frameworks push effective intelligence beyond single-model scaling limits by 2027?
